title: KnowMe Paper Radar: Lightweight Discovery of Promising Papers in the Age of Autoresearch
abstract: arXiv:2611.23702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing volume of topically similar papers makes it difficult to identify new work that can offer useful research insights or methodological guidance. We present KnowMe Paper Radar, a lightweight discovery tool that combines multiple sources of evidence into personalized reading priorities. Users specify topics, priorities, exclusions and dates; the system brings together topical relevance, recency, author research histories, collaboration paths and direction-specific institutional context. By exposing each score component and its supporting sources, KnowMe helps readers select promising papers for their current questions and discover relevant work beyond familiar authors. Automatic acquisition, version merging and graph-cache reuse keep this workflow convenient without large language model (LLM) inference during ordinary use. translated_title: KnowMe 论文雷达：自动科研时代的轻量级潜力论文发现工具
translated_abstract: 主题相似的论文数量不断增长，使得人们难以从中识别出能够提供有用研究见解或方法指导的新工作。我们提出了 KnowMe Paper Radar，这是一个轻量级的论文发现工具，它将多种证据来源综合成个性化的阅读优先级。用户可以指定主题、优先级、排除项和日期；系统会综合考量主题相关性、时效性、作者研究历史、合作路径以及特定研究方向上的机构背景。通过公开每个评分组成部分及其支持来源，KnowMe 帮助读者为其当前的研究问题挑选有前景的论文，并发现熟悉作者圈之外的相关工作。自动获取、版本合并和图缓存重用使这一工作流程保持便捷，在常规使用中无需大语言模型（LLM）推理。在 174,640 条获取记录上的实验显示，重复上下文准备的速度提升了三倍以上，同时……
tldr: KnowMe Paper Radar 是一个无需 LLM 推理的轻量级论文发现工具，它综合主题相关性、时效性、作者研究历史、合作路径和机构背景等多源证据生成个性化阅读优先级，帮助研究者快速筛选潜力论文，并将重复上下文准备速度提升三倍以上。
en_tdlr: KnowMe Paper Radar is a lightweight, LLM-free paper discovery tool that fuses topical relevance, recency, author research histories, collaboration paths, and institutional context into personalized reading priorities, helping researchers efficiently surface promising papers while achieving over threefold faster repeated context preparation.
